title: Approval of Lifeguarding Services Agreements with Consolidated Fire Protection
text:
Approval of Lifeguarding Services Agreements with Consolidated Fire Protection
  District of Los Angeles County for Venice Beach and Outer Cabrillo
  Beach – Categorically Exempt from the Provisions of the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 19, Section 15301
  [Operation, Repair, Maintenance, Permitting, Leasing, Licensing, or Minor
  Alteration of Existing Public or Private Structures, Facilities, Mechanical
  Equipment, or Topographical Features, Involving Negligible or No Expansion of
  Existing or Former Use] of California CEQA Guidelines as well as Article III,
  Section 1, Class 1(1) and Class 1(14) of City CEQA Guidelines
summary: Approval of Lifeguarding Services Agreements with Consolidated Fire Protection District for Venice Beach and Outer Cabrillo Beach.

details.applicant: Consolidated Fire Protection District of Los Angeles County
